008package paint.shared.io.internal;
009
010import paint.shared.objects.Recording;
011
012import tech.tablesaw.api.Row;
013import tech.tablesaw.api.Table;
014
015import java.util.ArrayList;
016import java.util.List;
017
018import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
019
020/**
021 * Handles low-level I/O and data conversion between PAINT {@link Recording} objects and
022 * Tablesaw {@link Table} structures.
023 * <p>
024 * The {@code RecordingsTableIO} class provides implementation for mapping recording entity
025 * fields to CSV columns and vice versa. It manages the schema specific to "recordings.csv"
026 * files, ensuring that data types and headers are correctly applied during conversion.
027 * </p>
028 */
029public class RecordingsTableIO extends BaseTableIO {
030
031    // =====================================================================
032    //  TABLE CREATION
033    // =====================================================================
034
035    /**
036     * @return a new empty {@link Table} with the Recordings schema.
037     */
038    public Table emptyTable() {
039        return newEmptyTable("Recordings", Recording.Column.values(), c -> c.header, c -> c.type);
040    }
041
042    // =====================================================================
043    //  ENTITY → TABLE CONVERSION
044    // =====================================================================
045
046    /**
047     * Converts a list of {@link Recording} entities into a Tablesaw {@link Table}.
048     *
049     * @param recordings list of recording objects to convert
050     * @return a table containing the recording data
051     */
052    public Table toTable(List<Recording> recordings) {
053        Table table = emptyTable();
054
055        for (Recording recording : recordings) {
056            Row row = table.appendRow();
057
058            row.setString(  EXPERIMENT_NAME,                 recording.getExperimentName());
059            row.setString(  RECORDING_NAME,                  recording.getRecordingName());
060            row.setInt(     CONDITION_NUMBER,                recording.getConditionNumber());
061            row.setInt(     REPLICATE_NUMBER,                recording.getReplicateNumber());
062            row.setString(  PROBE_NAME,                      recording.getProbeName());
063            row.setString(  PROBE_TYPE,                      recording.getProbeType());
064            row.setString(  CELL_TYPE,                       recording.getCellType());
065            row.setString(  ADJUVANT,                        recording.getAdjuvant());
066            row.setDouble(  CONCENTRATION,                   recording.getConcentration());
067            row.setBoolean( PROCESS_FLAG,                    recording.isProcessFlagSet());
068            row.setDouble(  THRESHOLD,                       recording.getThreshold());
069            row.setInt(     NUMBER_OF_SPOTS,                 recording.getNumberOfSpots());
070            row.setInt(     NUMBER_OF_TRACKS,                recording.getNumberOfTracks());
071            row.setInt(     NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_BACKGROUND, recording.getNumberOfSquaresInBackground());
072            row.setInt(     NUMBER_OF_TRACKS_IN_BACKGROUND,  recording.getNumberOfTracksInBackground());
073            row.setDouble(  AVERAGE_TRACKS_IN_BACKGROUND,    recording.getAverageTracksInBackGround());
074            row.setInt(     NUMBER_OF_SPOTS_IN_ALL_TRACKS,   recording.getNumberOfSpotsInAllTracks());
075            row.setInt(     NUMBER_OF_FRAMES,                recording.getNumberOfFrames());
076            row.setDouble(  RUN_TIME,                        recording.getRunTime());
077            row.setDateTime(TIME_STAMP,                      recording.getTimeStamp());
078            row.setBoolean( EXCLUDE,                         recording.isExcluded());
079            row.setDouble(  TAU,                             recording.getTau());
080            row.setDouble(  R_SQUARED,                       recording.getRSquared());
081            row.setDouble(  DENSITY,                         recording.getDensity());
082            row.setDouble(  MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO,      recording.getMinRequiredDensityRatio());
083            row.setDouble(  MIN_REQUIRED_R_SQUARED,          recording.getMinRequiredRSquared());
084            row.setDouble(  MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY,       recording.getMaxAllowableVariability());
085            row.setString(  NEIGHBOUR_MODE,                  recording.getNeighbourMode());
086        }
087
088        return table;
089    }
090
091    // =====================================================================
092    //  TABLE → ENTITY CONVERSION
093    // =====================================================================
094
095    /**
096     * Converts a Tablesaw {@link Table} into a list of {@link Recording} entities.
097     *
098     * @param table the table to convert
099     * @return a list of recording objects
100     */
101    public List<Recording> toEntities(Table table) {
102        List<Recording> recordings = new ArrayList<>();
103
104        for (Row tablesawRow : table) {
105            Recording recording = new Recording();
106
107            recording.setExperimentName(              tablesawRow.getString(   EXPERIMENT_NAME));
108            recording.setRecordingName(               tablesawRow.getString(   RECORDING_NAME));
109            recording.setConditionNumber(             tablesawRow.getInt(      CONDITION_NUMBER));
110            recording.setReplicateNumber(             tablesawRow.getInt(      REPLICATE_NUMBER));
111            recording.setProbeName(                   tablesawRow.getString(   PROBE_NAME));
112            recording.setProbeType(                   tablesawRow.getString(   PROBE_TYPE));
113            recording.setCellType(                    tablesawRow.getString(   CELL_TYPE));
114            recording.setAdjuvant(                    tablesawRow.getString(   ADJUVANT));
115            recording.setConcentration(               tablesawRow.getDouble(   CONCENTRATION));
116            recording.setProcessFlag(                 tablesawRow.getBoolean(  PROCESS_FLAG));
117            recording.setThreshold(                   tablesawRow.getDouble(   THRESHOLD));
118            recording.setNumberOfSpots(               tablesawRow.getInt(      NUMBER_OF_SPOTS));
119            recording.setNumberOfTracks(              tablesawRow.getInt(      NUMBER_OF_TRACKS));
120            recording.setNumberOfSquaresInBackground( tablesawRow.getInt(      NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_BACKGROUND));
121            recording.setNumberOfTracksInBackground(  tablesawRow.getInt(      NUMBER_OF_TRACKS_IN_BACKGROUND));
122            recording.setAverageTracksInBackGround(   tablesawRow.getDouble(   AVERAGE_TRACKS_IN_BACKGROUND));
123            recording.setNumberOfSpotsInAllTracks(    tablesawRow.getInt(      NUMBER_OF_SPOTS_IN_ALL_TRACKS));
124            recording.setNumberOfFrames(              tablesawRow.getInt(      NUMBER_OF_FRAMES));
125            recording.setRunTime(                     tablesawRow.getDouble(   RUN_TIME));
126            recording.setTimeStamp(                   tablesawRow.getDateTime( TIME_STAMP));
127            recording.setExcluded(                    tablesawRow.getBoolean(  EXCLUDE));
128            recording.setTau(                         tablesawRow.getDouble(   TAU));
129            recording.setRSquared(                    tablesawRow.getDouble(   R_SQUARED));
130            recording.setDensity(                     tablesawRow.getDouble(   DENSITY));
131            recording.setMinRequiredDensityRatio(     tablesawRow.getDouble(   MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO));
132            recording.setMinRequiredRSquared(         tablesawRow.getDouble(   MIN_REQUIRED_R_SQUARED));
133            recording.setMaxAllowableVariability(     tablesawRow.getDouble(   MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY));
134            recording.setNeighbourMode(               tablesawRow.getString(   NEIGHBOUR_MODE));
135
136            recordings.add(recording);
137        }
138
139        return recordings;
140    }
141}
